Priya / team — forwarding the thread. I pulled the account history and attached a short usage export (acme_usage_report.csv) plus account_history.pdf and a raw suspicious-ip-log.txt snapshot. High-level findings:

- Three trial top-ups in the last 28 days from the same billing contact but different sign-up emails.
- Usage pattern shows many short-lived sessions that spike token usage within a minute (common with automated stress tests).
- Two failed payment attempts followed by a successful retry on the same day last month.
- Several sessions originate from a small set of IPs that map to cloud provider ranges and inconsistent geo lookups.

Recommendation: hold the 25k approval until we complete a short verification: confirm corporate domain ownership for eng emails, request a company billing contact confirmation, and validate there are no duplicate accounts tied to the same org. If Sales still wants to proceed urgently, we can offer a limited 10k provisional credit with monitoring and automatic rollback on anomalous signals.

Attachments: acme_usage_report.csv (attachment), account_history.pdf (attachment), suspicious-ip-log.txt (attachment)

-Vivek

Vivek / team,

I finished a quick fraud check and corroborated the flagged items. Evidence summary:
- Account created six weeks ago; two other trial accounts share billing contact phone number +1 650-555-0112.
- IP clusters: three CIDR blocks used repeatedly across accounts; reverse DNS indicates ephemeral hostnames in the same cloud region.
- Usage velocity: >85% of requests are <10 tokens but fired at sub-second intervals — looks like scripted load tests oriented to burn quota rather than evaluate model quality.

Suggested next steps (in order):
1) Put a temporary hold on additional large credit grants.
2) Ask AcmeAI for company registration docs and a billing contact confirmation.
3) Offer a monitored 10k provisional credit if they sign a short pilot MOU and agree to rate limits for the first 72 hours.
4) If they refuse verification or we see immediate anomalous activity after provisional grant, revoke credits and mark as suspected abuse.

Happy to join a quick call with Priya and Sales if needed.

-Neha

Alex —

Thanks for your patience while we reviewed. We can't approve the full 25k credits right now due to signals consistent with automated quota consumption across multiple trial accounts tied to your organization. Our fraud team has asked for a brief verification step before granting larger top-ups.

Two options to move forward quickly:

1) Verification path (fastest): please reply with a company registration PDF and confirm the primary billing contact (name and phone). Once we receive those, we will clear the account for a 20k grant within 48 hours.

2) Provisional pilot: sign a short MOU and we will provision 10k credits immediately under tightened rate limits and active monitoring (we will automatically suspend if anomalous signals are detected).

If neither option works, we can also talk about a paid pilot (procurement/PO) to remove credit restrictions.

I know this is inconvenient — we try to balance fast trials with protecting our platform and other customers. Let me know which option you prefer and we can expedite.

Best,
